handoff.summary: Qualified authentic deterministic batches 0:4 through 84:4, then recovered the timed-out 88:4 batch from four independently supervised authenticated column fragments. The ordered assembler published one canonical ordinary v1 capsule/receipt, and global resume state is 23 complete, 53 missing, zero capsule-only.
risks: The killed four-column v1 worker emits native timing only after return; its >591-second native attribution is inferred from measured setup overhead, while the four isolated fragments total only 379679 ms of native time
Ordinary ranges beginning at 92 have not yet resumed, so later slow-batch behavior remains unknown
next_steps: After explicit resource authorization, resume the ordinary deterministic campaign at 92:4 with the unchanged fail-stop controller
If a later ordinary batch reaches the fixed timeout, use the same authenticated fragment protocol rather than relaxing resource limits
